verdict.rationale: Blaxel sandboxes let you run arbitrary shell processes and build custom sandbox images (via Dockerfile) supporting any language runtime, and provide file/process/log APIs to retrieve execution output (blaxel-docs-17, blaxel-docs-32, blaxel-docs-20). However, there is no explicit documentation naming specific supported language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, etc.) or describing 'rich' structured results (e.g., images, tables, rendered output) beyond raw process logs. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported language runtimes, examples of running Python/JS code snippets, and documentation of rich/structured result formats beyond text logs.
